main_text.p: mnium Ecclesiarum Re-formatarum, de eodem ar-ticulo, doctrinâ, juxta ver-bum Dei. Specialiter au-tem, in iis, quę ex meis in Decalogum commentariis citavit, nihil illum mihi affinxisse, sed mentem meam expresisse, & sen-tentiam, quam veram judi-co. Cum tamen mihi scru-pulus quidam injectus fu-isset ex eo, quod quaest. 3. ubi agitur de depositione Ministrorum, non objecti-vam solum, sed etiam for-malem potestatem Magi-

page.notes: The first word reads "mnium"; the first letter is cut off at the left edge of the scan, probably "o" (omnium), so it stays a fragment. "expresisse" is hard to read with certainty; the long s is written as plain s. No page number or running head is printed.
